The '''Regulator Command Center''' was a major base of the [[InterStellar Regulators]] on [[Aboro Mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. It included a communications hub and hangar built into part of the mesa, as well as a shuttlepad, and was the Regulators' main base on Aboro Mesa during the [[Conquest of Makeb]].
